transcript.en: Excuse me, I was told to come here for advice about, erm, Management Diploma courses?
transcript.zh: 打扰一下，我被告知来这里咨询管理文凭的课程？

transcript.en: You've certainly come to the right place.
transcript.zh: 你来对地方了。

transcript.en: Hi, my name is Monica.
transcript.zh: 你好，我叫莫尼卡。

transcript.en: Nice to meet you.
transcript.zh: 见到你很高兴。

transcript.en: My name is Andrew, Andrew Harris.
transcript.zh: 我叫安德鲁，安德鲁·哈里斯。

transcript.en: So, Andrew, have you seen our diploma course prospectus yet?
transcript.zh: 那么安德鲁，你看我们课程的招生简章了吗？

transcript.en: Yes, I've already looked at it.
transcript.zh: 是的，我看了。

transcript.en: In fact, I thought the information on course content was really useful, but I'm afraid I'm a bit confused by all the different ways you can do the course: full-time intensive, part-time and so on.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我认为课程内容的介绍十分有用，但是我恐怕对上课的形式有点疑问：全日制、非全日制课程等等。

transcript.en: Well, let's see if I can help.
transcript.zh: 让我看看能否帮到你。

transcript.en: I think each course type has its advantages and disadvantages, so it really depends on you - your own study habits, and your financial circumstances, of course.
transcript.zh: 我认为每种课程的形式各有利弊，所以这取决于你，你的学习习惯，经济状况。

transcript.en: Are you working at the moment?
transcript.zh: 你现在工作了吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: I've been working in the administration section of the local hospital for the last three years.
transcript.zh: 我过去的3年一直在当地医院的管理部门工作。

transcript.en: And before that I worked in the office of a computer engineering company for two years.
transcript.zh: 在此之前的两年，我在电脑公司的办公室工作。

transcript.en: So, I've got about five years of relevant work experience.
transcript.zh: 所以我在相关方面有5年的工作经验。

transcript.en: And what I'm hoping to focus on is Personnel Management.
transcript.zh: 我希望重点放在人事管理方面。

transcript.en: I see.
transcript.zh: 我明白了。

transcript.en: And are you planning to leave your current job to study, or are you thinking about just taking a year off ?
transcript.zh: 你打算辞去现在的工作去学习还是请一年的假？

transcript.en: I want to know what my options are, really.
transcript.zh: 我想知道我能有什么选择。

transcript.en: I don't want to quit my job or anything and my employers are keen for me to get some more qualifications but obviously, it would be better if I could do a course without taking too much time away from work.
transcript.zh: 我想知道我能有什么选择我不想辞职，我的老板想让我获得更多的资质，但是显然如果我不用占用很多工作时间又能上课是最好的了。

transcript.en: Right, so you don't really want to do the full-time course, then?
transcript.zh: 那么你不想上全日制课程了？

transcript.en: No, not really.
transcript.zh: 不。

transcript.en: It's also a question of finances.
transcript.zh: 还有一个资金问题。

transcript.en: You see, my office have agreed to pay the cost of the course itself, but I would have to take unpaid leave if I want to study full-time and, well, I don't think I could afford to support myself with no salary for a whole year.
transcript.zh: 我的公司同意付课程费，但是如果我上全日制课程，我得请无薪假。我觉得我无法一整年都没有薪水的生活下去。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Well, you have two other possibilities: you could either do the part-time course - that would be over two years and you wouldn't have to take any time off work - or you could do what we call a 'modular' course.
transcript.zh: 你有两种选择。你可以上非全日制课程，这不会占用你的工作时间，两年完成，或者你可以上模块化课程。

transcript.en: You could do that in eighteen months if you wanted - or longer, it's quite flexible and it would be up to you.
transcript.zh: 你可以用18个月完成或更久的时间，这个很灵活，完全取决于你。

transcript.en: Mmm.
transcript.zh: 额。

transcript.en: So what does the part-time course involve?
transcript.zh: 那么非全日制课程包括什么？

transcript.en: For that you would join an evening class and have a lecture twice a week.
transcript.zh: 你可以上晚间课程，每周有两个讲座。

transcript.en: Then, you'd have to attend a seminar or discussion workshop one weekend a month.
transcript.zh: 之后，你会在每月的一个周末参加讨论会或研讨班。

transcript.en: What kind of coursework would I have to do?
transcript.zh: 我要做什么作业？

transcript.en: Well, it's a mixture.
transcript.zh: 各种各样的作业。

transcript.en: You'd be expected to write an essay each month, which counts towards your final assessment.
transcript.zh: 你每月要写一份论文，这将记入你的最终评定，

transcript.en: You have a case study to do by the end of the course, which might involve doing a survey or something like that, and also you need to hand in a short report every four weeks.
transcript.zh: 课程结束的时候你要做案例研究，这包括调查之类的事情。另外每四周你要交一份短篇报告。

transcript.en: So, that's quite a lot of work, then, on top of working every day.
transcript.zh: 所以除了每天工作之外，还有很多作业要做。

transcript.en: It sounds like a lot of studying - and really tiring.
transcript.zh: 听起来有很多要学的，真累人。

transcript.en: Yeah, you certainly wouldn't have much free time!
transcript.zh: 是的，你肯定没有很多空闲时间了。

transcript.en: What about the 'modular' course?
transcript.zh: 模块化课程怎么样？

transcript.en: What would I have to do for that?
transcript.zh: 我要做些什么？

transcript.en: That's where you get the opportunity to study full-time for short periods.
transcript.zh: 你将有机会在短时间内完成全日制的课程。

transcript.en: That way you can cover a lot of coursework and attend lectures and seminars during the day.
transcript.zh: 那样你可以完成很多课程，白天要参加讲座和研讨班。

transcript.en: And each module lasts for one term, say, about twelve weeks at a time.
transcript.zh: 每个模块课程持续一学期，大约一次是12周。

transcript.en: There are obvious advantages in this - the main one being that you can study in a much more intensive way, which suits some people much better.
transcript.zh: 这显然有很多优点，主要的一点是你可以集中强化学习，这点对一些人很适合。

transcript.en: And how many of these 'modules' would I have to do to get the diploma?
transcript.zh: 上这种模块化课程，我应该做些什么才能获得学位？

transcript.en: The current programme is two modules - and then you have to choose a topic to work in more depth - but you can base that on your job, and so you don't need to be away from the office, and how long it takes is up to you.
transcript.zh: 目前的计划是两种模块，你要选择一个主题进行深入研究，但是你可以参考你的工作。你不用离开办公室，上多久也取决于你。

transcript.en: The important thing is that you don't have to study and work.
transcript.zh: 重要的是你不用既上班又学习。

transcript.en: You can focus on one thing at a time.
transcript.zh: 你可以一次专注于一件事。

transcript.en: Yes, I can see that.
transcript.zh: 是的，我明白了。

transcript.en: It certainly sounds attractive!
transcript.zh: 听起来很诱人 。

transcript.en: It would be more expensive, though.
transcript.zh: 但是也更贵一些。

transcript.en: I mean, I'd have to support myself without pay for each module.
transcript.zh: 我的意思是，我学这些模块期间没收入。

transcript.en: That's true, so that might be a problem for you.
transcript.zh: 确实, 所以这对你来说可能是一个问题。

transcript.en: Look, why don't you talk this over with your employers and...
transcript.zh: 那么，为什么不跟你的老板谈谈......
